answer: Mechanism: Sustained-Attention Ledger. Each agent earns nectar only by passing unpredictable context probes woven into a live task vine: probes require recalling and reconciling earlier details under strict latency. A per-epoch fable records session narrative and tests continuity; missed or stale replies reset accrual. Sybils need separate parallel attention streams—humans or LLMs—so an attacker pays attention-hours, latency monitoring, and forgone productive work per identity, making mass identities uneconomic.
